subject.title: feat(ui): group native session catalog rows by project in the sidebar

question: Should users with no existing catalog-grouping preference receive the new grouped view by default on upgrade, or retain the shipped flat view until they opt in?
rationale: The new localStorage default intentionally changes existing users' sidebar organization, and tests cannot determine which upgrade experience maintainers want.

options.title: Default to grouped
options.body: Keep the proposed default-on behavior after the Windows path fix and live catalog proof, accepting the reversible UI change for existing users.

options.title: Preserve flat default
options.body: Treat an absent preference as flat and require users to enable project grouping explicitly, preserving the shipped upgrade experience.

recommendation.title: Default to grouped
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed default-on behavior after the Windows path fix and live catalog proof, accepting the reversible UI change for existing users.

likelyOwner.reason: The current history and protected maintainer signal connect this owner most directly to the Control UI and native-session catalog product direction.
